newsitem.title: USA: Rawson-Koenig to pay $2.15/shr in tender.
newsitem.headline: Rawson-Koenig to pay $2.15/shr in tender.

text.p: Rawson-Koenig Inc said Wednesday that its board has approved a tender offer under which it will buy all outstanding shares of company stock not owned by the Rawson family for $2.15 per share.
The Rawson family owns 60 percent of the company's outstanding shares. Rawson-Koenig's common stock closed at $1.875 on Nasdaq Tuesday.
The tender offer will be followed immediately by a 1-for-100 reverse stock split, it said. Following that, the company will merge with an unidentified company, it said.
The company said it will pay all fees and expenses of the tender offer, and sellers will not be required to pay any brokerage fees or commissions.
After the reverse split, all remaining odd-lot shareholders will be paid $2.15 per share in cash for each share held before the split.

All remaining shares not purchased in the tender offer or the reverse split will be converted into the right to receive $2.15 per share, as adjusted for the reverse split, in a merger to be consummated as soon as practicable following the tender offer.
